data.desc: Advance Auto Parts, Inc. is a leading automotive aftermarket parts provider that serves both professional installers and do-it-yourself customers. As of October 10, 2026, Advance operated 4,325 stores primarily within the United States, with additional locations in Canada, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. The Company also served 787 independently owned Carquest branded stores across these locations in addition to various Caribbean islands.
